name: CrateTests
shortDesc: AI-powered study tool that transforms notes into quizzes and flashcards.
fullDesc: A full-stack web application SaaS that uses AI to transform study materials into interactive learning tools. Upload notes or documents, and the platform automatically generates personalized quizzes and flashcards with adaptive difficulty and spaced repetition algorithms. Built with a React frontend and Node.js backend, integrating machine learning models for intelligent content generation.

name: StructSprint
shortDesc: Interactive coding platform for practicing data structures and algorithms in Java, C, and Python.
fullDesc: A full-stack web application that provides interactive coding challenges focused on data structures and algorithms. Users can solve problems in Java or C, with real-time code execution and automated test validation powered by Judge0. Built with React frontend and Firebase Cloud Functions backend, featuring 30+ curated challenges covering linked lists, binary trees, graphs, stacks, queues, and arrays. Each challenge includes comprehensive test cases, instant feedback, in depth descriptions, and support for both function-based and class-based implementations.

name: Voice Age & Gender Classifier
shortDesc: ML model that predicts age group and gender from voice recordings.
fullDesc: A machine learning system trained on Mozilla Common Voice dataset to classify speakers by age group and gender from audio. Features a CNN architecture processing MFCC audio features, achieving 87% age accuracy and 99% gender accuracy. Try it yourself by recording your voice!

name: Isometric 2D Game Engine
shortDesc: Custom game engine with rendering, input handling, and tile-based world design.
fullDesc: Developed an isometric 2D game engine from the ground up, focusing on rendering, input handling, asset management, and layered tile-based world design. This experience challenged me to think critically about performance, architecture, and modular design principles. Gained a deeper understanding of graphics rendering pipelines, coordinate transformations for isometric projection, and efficient game loop implementation.

name: Windows Application Usage Monitor
shortDesc: Tracks active usage time for all foreground applications on Windows.
fullDesc: Developed a native Windows application in C that monitors active usage time for all foreground applications, including browsers, games, and productivity software. Data is persisted in JSON across sessions and served via a local web server, with an interactive web UI built with HTML/CSS/JS featuring tables and charts to visualize application usage. This project involved low-level Windows API programming, high-resolution timers, and designing a lightweight local web interface.
